# DSH Plugin Scout
English | 中文
[](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml) · MIT
Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins published under the GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`, from ins
ide DSH. Plugins are grouped by purpose, ranked by trust score, and checked against the official pee
r-compatibility rule. Supports DSH **0.2.x** (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`); tested on desktop 0.2.0-rc.2.
> The in-app UI is currently Chinese only. The plugin's title and description in the official Plugin
s page are localized (`locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`).
## Install
Open the official **Plugins** page → **Add plugin**, and enter one of:
| Spec | Notes |
| `dsh-plugin-scout` | Recommended. Prebuilt npm package with provenance; no install scripts, no bui

ld approval needed |
| Absolute path of a prebuilt `dsh-plugin-scout-<version>.tgz`, if supplied wit
h a release | Bypasses the npm registry; the current tag workflow creates release notes only and doe
s not attach a tarball |
From the CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-scout`. Enable it on the Plugins page,
then open **Plugins → Scout**. The tab is labeled **Scout** in both languages; no sidebar entry is a
dded. The official **Discover** tab is unchanged.
Do not install from `github:fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout`: a git install fetches source without `lib/`, a
nd this repository deliberately ships no `prepare` script.
## Native Discover index
Add this URL in the official **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** dialog:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This is a format-1 catalog, not an embedded Scout page. You do not need to install Scout to browse i
t. GitHub Actions rebuilds it daily at 03:23 UTC and on generator changes, then deploys only after t
he official DSH validator accepts the document. Failed generation leaves the previous deployment int
fficial DSH validator accepts the document. Failed generation leaves the previous deployment intact.
The public catalog contains deduplicated npm bundles compatible with the target DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with
a matching repository, no install hooks, and advertised provenance. Archived, risky, version-drifte
d, stale or incomplete entries are excluded. Forks retain a source label. Provenance presence is not
cryptographic verification or a security guarantee. Each entry pins the npm version and uses npm's
real release time; the official installer remains the final authority. The target runtime is a publi
shing policy, not a compatibility claim for every DSH release.
Generate from public GitHub/npm data with `GH_TOKEN=<read-only-token> node scripts/generate-market.m
js`. `MARKET_OUTPUT`, `SCOUT_CACHE`, and `DSH_TARGET` override the output, disposable crawl cache, a
nd target runtime. No local profile or user cache is published. The generated `site/index.json` and
crawl cache are ignored by Git; CI uploads only the public catalog as the Pages artifact. Adding the
source remains your explicit action; Scout does not alter configured index sources.
## One-click install, through the official installer
The **Install** button in the details drawer takes the same path as the official **Add plugin**: `in
spect` first, then `installBundle(spec, {enabled: false, requestId, registry})`. Installed plugins s
tart **disabled**; **Enable** is a separate click (`setBundleEnabled`).
- Plugins with install hooks, or whose DSH peers do not cover the running version, need a second cli

ck to install.
- When the official installer blocks dependency build scripts (`pendingBuilds`), they

are listed by name; a double click on **Allow and reinstall** retries with `approvedBuilds`.
- **Ca
ncel install** calls `cancelInstall` with the same `requestId`; a lost reply is recovered with `wait

ForInstall`. On failure the official installer restores `package.json` and the lockfile.
- **Uninsta
lling and version exemptions stay on the official Plugins page.** Scout never calls `removeBundle`;
the tests fail if it does. Without the official `pluginManager`, the Install button is hidden and th
e drawer falls back to "copy pinned spec + open the Plugins page".
## Data sources (first-party only)
| Source | Used for |
| GitHub GraphQL `search(topic:dsh-plugin)` | Repository metadata, root `package.json`, `cordis.patc

h.yml` text (never evaluated) |
| `registry.npmjs.org/<name>/latest` | The manifest that would actua

lly be installed: peers, install hooks, `repository`, provenance |
| Official `pluginManager.listBun
dles` / `inspect` | Installed state; the official pre-install check (resolves only, runs no code) |
| Official `pluginManager.installBundle` / `waitForInstall` / `cancelInstall` / `setBundleEnabled` |
One-click install (disabled by default), cancel, separate enable; progress from `plugin-manager/ins
tall-state` and `install-log` events |
No third-party marketplace or aggregator is used. Topic searches explicitly use `fork:true` to inclu
de both original repositories and forks; forks retain their source notice and undergo the same check
s. After upgrading from 0.1.5 or earlier, use **Rebuild full index** once to discover older forks om
itted by the previous search scope.

## Security boundaries
- Exact routes use official `connection.fetch` under `/api/dsh-plugin-scout/api/*`, shared by deskto
p and Web carriers. The carrier authenticates requests and refuses non-owner peers before dispatch;
Scout additionally requires `x-dsh-plugin-scout: 1`. No independent loopback server or auth-token co

pying is used. The `connection` service is required.
- `cordis.patch.yml` is scanned for `name:` wit
h a regex; YAML tags are never parsed. Crawled code is never executed and tarballs are never downloa

ded.
- Style tags carry `data-plugin` / `data-plugin-css` before entering the DOM. Only `--dsw-alias
-*` tokens are used; class names avoid substrings that host skins target; the drawer does not use `r
used; class names avoid substrings that host skins target; the drawer does not use `role="dialog"`.
